capabilities.description: Builds and validates progress claims against the uploaded BOQ line items (P1-P5, E1-E5 in document:harbourline_boq.xlsx), checking quantities and rates, and applying the 5% retention per Interim Payment Certificate from Clause 14.3 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf.

Tracks the Clause 8.2 Time for Completion of 730 days from the Commencement Date, computes daily delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount under Clause 8.7, and enforces the 10% cap, per document:harbourline_contract.pdf.
Maintains QA inspection and test plan (ITP) records for civil works activities, with evidence capture and verification so inspection sign-offs are auditable against the document source of record.

Registers and versions contract, BOQ, and project documents, with retrieval and audit trails, ingesting the uploaded document:harbourline_boq.xlsx and document:harbourline_contract.pdf as the source of record.

Applies contract clause rules (retention under Clause 14.3, performance security of 10% under Clause 4.2, and the delay-damages cap under Clause 8.7) as governed rules from document:harbourline_contract.pdf, with approval gates for claim variations.
